commits.message: Updated project files for use with Eclipse indigo.

Added support for importing XCCDF-style documents.
Refactored KeyBuilder for use in generating Keys across multiple projects.
Refactored JUnit tests creating a base class that enables one-off imports and exports.
Renamed the meta model definition from oval-5.8-metamodel.xml to scap-metamodel.xml to better reflect its contents.
Updated the metamodel schema to support entity references from a static-document-model.

Made entity containers optional in the meta model.
Fixed various compile warnings.
Refactored packages for rest services.
Generalized the statistic service to report on stats for all entities and relationships.
Added pooling support for Marshaller/Unmarshaller in AbstractContentStore to allow for reuse and better efficiencies in processing since these are expensive to create.
Integrated AbstractContentStore into the content DB project.
Fixed exception handling in content DB store.
Added content DB store to the main build.
Added diagram of the meta model.
Removed build artifacts.
Moved project to trunk.
Added shutdown methods to MetadataStore, ContentStore and AbstractHybridContentPersistenceManager to dispatch the shutdown command to each component.
Fixed schema restriction error in the MetaModel.xsd relating to the entity-containers element and adjusted Java classes in the content-model appropriately.

Added support to the meta model for whole document entities.
Reorganized the bound schemas fixing schemaLocation issues.
Stubbed out the statistics capability in the ContentRepository, implementing as needed.

Added support for property generation in the meta model using a variety of contexts.
Using new property generation feature, insured that generated content is valid according to each XML model (e.g. OVAL, etc.)

Fixed the Maven build issue with JAXB allowing the project to be build from the root now.
Added javadoc comments to content-model.
Implemented indirect searching using identifier patterns.
Removed the mutable relationships since this code is no longer needed.
Fixed bug where System.getProperty was not getting called.
Refactored relationshipInfo collection getters to be initialized during repository initialization to save cycles.

Added support for SPI loading of ContentPersistenceManager and related component instances.
Refactored constructors related to constructing HybridContentPersistenceManager and related components.

Changed memory settings for surefire.
Removed warning messages from tests in log4j.xml.

Fixed issues with the download of USGCB content by checking in the content.
Fixed misc logging issues.

Added a capability on the MetadataModel in the getKeyFromMappedIdentifier(String) method that allows the detection of they key id and field ids for structured content identifiers (e.g. OVAL. OCIL, etc.).
Created a REST WS using the new capability for structured identifier key translation that allows the user to query any structured identifier within the repository using the request: http://localhost:8080/content-repository-war-1.0-SNAPSHOT/rest/content/query/get/global/{id}/?resolve-relationships=true.
Created a QueryResultMessageBodyWriter that enables QueryResult java instances returned by REST services to be marshalled into the text/xml media type using the document generation capability.
Fixed a bug in the LocalResolver that was preventing relationship resolution from being turned off.
Fixed some errant copyright notices.

Created schema and code to wrap multiple documents produced by the repository.
Fixed goldin build issues.
Enhanced error logging for some classes.

Changed logging levels for various classes.  Deleted some unused code.
It looks like the maven-copy-pluggin 0.3-SNAPSHOT has disappeared from the repository.  I switched the required version to 0.2.1 which is the latest released version on 2/22/2011.
Exposed the getRelatedEntity method on Entity as a short-cut to following the key.
Fixed class breaking build.  This was left out from the previous commit.
Changed the persist interaction to enable a collection of entities to be persisted.
Fixed schema validation error in the MetaModel.xsd.

Updated the content-model to support importing content similar to the NVD vulnerability feed. There were specific model issues relating to the NVD Vulnerability model that were worked out. Specifically, the need exists to associate indirect relationships with properties in addition to types.
Added the NVD vulnerability feed to the import App and test classes.

Added a callback to allow the metadata store to request a ContentRetriever.
Changed log levels in TripleStoreFacadeMetaDataManager to trace and adjusted log4j.xml.

Started adding javadoc comments to interfaces in content-model.
Added javadoc comments to ContentRepository.
Refactored content repository and associated classes to support JUnit testing by allowing the MetadataModel and ContentPersistenceManager to be set by clients.
Added JUnit test to replicate App.java functionality.
Cleaned up empty packages and unused classes.
Moved JAXB binding for the MetadataModel schema from content-meta-model to content-model.

Refactored the content-meta-model and content-model projects moving the metamodel schema bindings to content-model.  This keeps everything model specific in content-meta-model and all generalized code in content-model.
Refactored JAXBContextFactory to support a more robust way of identifying metamodel JARs.
Fixed bug in JAXBClassImpl.java relating to how properties on Enum generated classes are handled.

Adjusted the persistence managers to take a MetadataModel argument in the constructor.
Changed the interface for ContentStore to allow the Entity to be passed in to be persisted.
Fixed a few maven build errors.

Added support in the model and repository for indirect relationships (e.g. CCE, CVE, CPE)
Updated the OVAL metamodel to indicate indirect relationships.
Added support for indirect querying (e.g. CCE to OVAL Definition).  The current query API is temporary until I can work out a better approach.
Addressed namespace prefix mapping issues in document generation.

Reorganized some packages and removed unused ones.
Developed basic document generation code that currently outputs to System.out.  Still need to integrate this code in the repository layer dealing with query and document generation.
Reorganized java packages.

Refactored the jaxb-reflection library to simplify its structure and function.
Changed Entity and related classes to work with JAXBElement data enabling storage as qualified XML fragments.
Removed unused packages.
Modified the OVAL 5.8 schema to make definition a global element.

Integrated resolver and query code.
Stubbed out persistence manager.
Replaced System.our/err with log4j
Updated App to perform a query.
Cleaned up unused code.

Added various ignore entries.
Added support for content download in repository main class and POM.
Added missing license header.
Initial commit of additional code.
Improved javadoc comments.
Checked in project settings.
Initial commit of JAXB reflection library.
